steps.note: Open the existing closed two-bid event directly in Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared event.
Open the awarding screen for the prepared closed event.
Allocate the available first line's full quantity to Vendor B, the closest expressible portion of the requested allocation.
Assert the available one-line allocation and its calculated proposal value; the second line and second awarded vendor are unavailable in this prepared state.
Create the award proposal from the allocation.
Assert that the proposal page opened.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Assert that the submitted proposal is pending approval.
